name: Vancouver Coastal Health Richmond Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at Richmond Hospital, care homes and health programs. You might work at the front desk, show people the way, visit with patients or help at events.
who_can_apply: The Richmond page says its volunteers are over 16 years of age. VCH looks for people who are reliable, patient and mature and who will follow its rules.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Volunteers can get reference letters, awards and events.
duration: 2 to 3 hours a week for at least 6 months
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply online any time.
how_to_apply: Fill in the Richmond form online. It takes 4 to 8 weeks. VCH runs a criminal record check. Then you have an interview, reference checks, orientation and training.
notes: Richmond Volunteer Services: 604-278-9711 ext. 384731, rhs.volunteerservices@vch.ca. Sites include Richmond Hospital, Minoru Residence, Richmond Lions Manor and Bridgeport. Use the 'Fill in an application' link on the Richmond page. VCH also links an information sheet for Richmond applicants (a PDF that did not open on Oct 19, 2026).
